sm_top.sm: A Ukrainian sea drone attack on Benghazi sank a small Russian warship, hit the dry cargo ship MV Angara, killed two Libyan naval officers, and wounded ten people.
Iran denies involvement in a drone attack in Kuwait that killed two Italian nationals.
Yemen's Houthis claim responsibility for attacks on a Saudi oil refinery and the Riyadh financial center.
The ICJ ruled that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya people, prompting international reactions and calls for accountability.
Saudi airstrikes in Yemen resulted in reported casualties, including at least 11 people killed.
Iran claimed it shot down a US drone near the Strait of Hormuz.
Houthis struck Saudi oil infrastructure as fighting in Yemen escalated.
International security operations and anti-gang raids in Haiti, including deployments of Sri Lankan and Salvadoran forces, resulted in numerous casualties including suspected gang
Poland plans to establish a no-fly zone near its eastern border following Russian airspace violations.
ADNOC L&S confirms one crew death following recent Middle East tanker attacks.
President Zelenskyy warned that Russia is preparing a massive missile strike.
The son of a Hamas leader reportedly survived an Israeli assassination attempt in Gaza.
Ukraine reported hitting five Russian warplanes, including three MiG-31s and two Su-34s, at Savasleyka air base.
A Russian ballistic missile attack on Kyiv injured seven people and damaged infrastructure.
A Houthi strike hit Saudi Arabia's Jizan refinery, killing one worker.
North Korean leader Kim Jong Un inspected facilities and called for an expanded deployment of tactical nuclear weapons.
Yemeni forces targeted Saudi Arabia's Red Sea ports.
Russia launched 155 drones at Ukraine in an attack that killed 6 people and injured 25, with air defenses intercepting multiple targets.
A Russian Aerospace Forces general was arrested following a Ukrainian strike on the Crimean Bridge.
The US military disabled another ship trying to breach the naval blockade on Iranian ports.
Ukraine strikes the Crimean Bridge, disrupting Russian supply routes.
Israeli strikes killed four Hamas operatives in Gaza, including a commander linked to the October 7 attacks.
Saudi-led airstrikes hit the Yemeni capital Sanaa in response to Houthi missile fire.
Russian drone strikes hit Kharkiv, causing casualties and damage to buildings including the Aviation Institute.
Yemeni government forces work to defend Aden against an advancing Houthi offensive.
RSF drone strikes in Sudan's Blue Nile State killed civilians and caused fires.
Ukrainian forces struck a ballistic missile fuel production plant in Russia's Tula Oblast.
Casualties from a Russian drone strike on Kharkiv rose to one dead and six injured.
Ukrainian drones struck two oil refineries in Samara, causing fires.
Russia targeted a Ukrainian cargo ship in the Black Sea and struck power plants amid reciprocal attacks.
Russian forces targeted a cargo ship in the Black Sea.
Communal clashes in Niger State, Nigeria, result in a death toll of 74.
Houthi sources report that Saudi airstrikes in western Yemen killed 11 people.
Houthi media report a Saudi strike kills 11 in Yemen.
The Arab coalition carried out airstrikes targeting Houthi military capabilities in Yemen.
Ukrainian drone attacks resulted in injuries in Novorossiysk and the closure of a bridge.
The Arab Coalition stated it carried out precision military operations destroying 50 military targets in Sanaa, Hodeidah, and Saada governorates.
An attack on a Niger National Guard compound leaves 13 soldiers killed and 20 wounded.
An armed group attack in western Niger killed 13 soldiers, according to the defense ministry.
Media outlets and hackers report at least 500,000 Russian fatalities on the Ukrainian front.
